versions.changelog:
Initial release of clash-verge-controller.

- Provides RESTful API control for Clash Verge based on the mihomo (Clash.Meta) core.
- Includes comprehensive configuration instructions, API call examples, and code samples in Python and Node.js.
- Supports node switching, connection monitoring, rule management, proxy info retrieval, delay testing, kernel restart, and more via API.
- Details security best practices and setup requirements.
- Links to detailed API reference and official documentation.
